excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: I would like input from all on whether payload request should be a classic ssz or progressive as in the spec. Similarly for versioned hashes

excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: I was the one to motivate the migration of new payload request to be progressive and I’m not sure if it was the correct decision

excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: My thinking was that in the future we may want to index specific fields in the new payload request using inclusion proof

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content: That's possible with and without progressive, no? The diff is just how forward compat that proof is.

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content: If new_paylaod_request_proof might rollback in CL to not being progressive, then maybe doesn't make sense I adjust EELS now, and maybe better wait?

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content: Might be good to try to settle consensus-specs on NewPayloadRequest and VersionedHashes reg progressive or not, since this bubbles up to execution-specs and indirectly new releases that forces guest program to adjust. Prefer the least amount of churn since is a long chain of coordination.

excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content: From my side, happy to wait for CL coredevs to decide and after we think all is stable, then do EELS adjustements, ere-guests, ELs/guest-programs, zkboost etc.

excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: Yes correct it’s the forward compatibility that would benefit from this. In any case with recursive proofs maybe this becomes a moot point as the new payload request is no longer a core data structure of the spec as we transition to the beacon block root as the primary commitment

excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: I think we should defer any change in EELS and come to consensus on the CL types first
